attributes.name: Warden of Thunder
attributes.powers:
The Warden of Thunder is immune to the Electricity trait.

Before the encounter, each character at this location must succeed at a Dexterity or Acrobatics 14 check or be dealt 1d4 Electricity damage.

Damage dealt by the Warden of Thunder during the check is dealt to each character at this location.

corrections.corrected_text: On the monster Warden of Thunder, add the italicized text to the second power: "Damage dealt by the Warden of Thunder during the check is dealt to each character..."
corrections.issue: On Warden of Thunder, how does the "damage is dealt to each character at the location" power interact with the "before the encounter" power?
